'''Cortney Haggerty''' (also published as '''Courtney Haggerty''')<ref name="dt-14067">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14067 Endor Shenanigans], DeckTech (Cortney "dope5tar" Haggerty, 27 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14067/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14067/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018042202/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14067/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''dope5tar''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in February 2001.
